note: First-run results of each held-out round, kept exactly as measured. After a round is measured, its misses may be fixed; from then on that round counts as development data and a fresh held-out round is written.

failures.problem: “Pro plan: ₹1,499/month” — plan aliases were not mapped
failures.fix: Rules can list plan aliases (Professional: “Pro”), matched as whole words

failures.problem: “Try it for a month, free” — durations in words were not parsed
failures.fix: Durations in words and in weeks or months are read and converted to days; a price's billing period is not mistaken for a trial

failures.problem: “Inkloom Ai” — a wrong capitalisation was not a listed variant
failures.fix: The approved spelling is exact: any other capitalisation of the product name is flagged

failures.problem: “80 percent” — a mapped claim was only matched with “80%”
failures.fix: Mapped claims match paraphrases: “percent”/“per cent” for “%”, “number one”/“#1” for “No. 1”, any spacing

failures.problem: “Best regards” — a sign-off was flagged as a superlative
failures.fix: “Best regards” and “best wishes” are recognised as sign-offs
